paragraphs.text: The Mistform are a type of illusion from Dominaria .

Misforms were a cycle of creatures in Onslaught . They all had activated abilities that allowed them to change their creature type to another for one colorless mana . The greatest of the mistform, Mistform Ultimus , was every creature type by default and became the inspiration for Changeling . Mistform creatures appeared as angels , birds , humans , mutants , slivers , and walls . A Mistform Sliver took the form of a junior researcher to escape the Riptide Project .
Several of the Mistform creatures reference five myths of reality in their flavor text . They are said to be Familiarity, Devotion, Conviction, Fellowship, and Trust.
